meta.title: BG3 Companion Area Guide content seed

priority_levels.must: Real companion quest/cutscene/reward/permanent consequence; worth changing party for.
priority_levels.strong: Meaningful unique content or major personal context; usually worth a switch.
priority_levels.contextual: Quest-relevant but active presence is not required; switch only if you want continuity.
priority_levels.flavor: Unique remarks/banter/lore only; do not create FOMO.
priority_levels.none: No meaningful companion-specific reason to change party.

design_principles.switch_worth_it: True only when the player should seriously consider going to camp to swap companions.
design_principles.evidence_rule: Do not upgrade a recommendation merely because a companion has a location remark or approval change.
design_principles.spoiler_rule: Default UI copy should explain why a companion matters without revealing outcomes; exact consequences go behind an expand/spoiler control.

primary_sources: Selected r/BaldursGate3 community threads for flavor/banter consensus
meta.research_status: 51 original seed records retained; targeted verification only. Karlach at Devil’s Den is player-observed, not independently confirmed.
